To work out $\left(\dfrac{3}{5}\right)^3,$ we multiply $\dfrac{3}{5}$ by itself and then multiply the result by $\dfrac{3}{5}$ again:

$$
\begin{aligned}{(\frac{3}{5})}^{3} & =\frac{3}{5}\cdot \frac{3}{5}\cdot \frac{3}{5} \\  & =\frac{3\cdot 3\cdot 3}{5\cdot 5\cdot 5} \\  & =\frac{27}{125}\end{aligned}
$$
